map.周转率越高说明库存利用效率越好，但过低有断供风险: Higher turnover means better inventory efficiency, but too low risks stockout.

map.资金优化：对比当前与建议库存的资金占用差额: Capital optimization: compare capital occupation of current vs suggested stock.
map.算法：年消耗量 = 日均消耗×365；周转率 = 年消耗/当前库存（次/年）；周: Algorithm: annual consumption = daily times 365; turnover rate = annual / current stock (times/yr); turnover days = stock / daily; suggested stock = daily times (cycle + safety days); stock difference = current - suggested; capital occupation = stock times unit cost; reorder point = daily times cycle. Assessment: turnover days >90 overstocked, >60 high, <(cycle+safety) times 0.8 low with stockout risk, <cycle severe shortage, else reasonable.
map.例：库存 500、日耗 10、采购周期 15 天、安全库存 7 天、单价 50: Example: stock 500, daily 10, cycle 15 days, safety 7 days, unit 50 CNY -> annual 3650, turnover 7.30 /yr, turnover days 50.0, suggested 220, surplus 280, capital 25000 CNY (suggested 11000), reorder point 150, assessment: reasonable stock, normal turnover. If stock drops to 80 -> turnover 45.63 /yr, turnover days 8.0, shortage 140, capital 4000, assessment: low stock, stockout risk, replenish advised. If stock rises to 1200 -> turnover days 120.0, turnover 3.04 /yr, surplus 980, capital 60000, hint: overstocked, slow turnover.

map.再订购点 = 日均×采购周期，是「触发下单的库存水位」；建议库存 = 日均×(采: Reorder point = daily times cycle, the inventory level that triggers an order; suggested stock = daily times (cycle + safety days), the target level after replenishment. The former decides when to order, the latter how much per order; together they avoid both stockout and overstock.
